• *From Cartagena:* 2.175.000 COP online or 2.417.000 COP without booking online.
• *If you’re already on the Rosario Islands:* 1.870.000 COP online or 2.080.000 COP without booking online.

The same goes for multi-day dive packages (4, 5, 7 and 9 dives): you stay on the islands, and accommodation, which is not included, is booked directly with the hotel.
